content: 非常經典的老北京四合院的環境，環境好，隔音好，更值得點讚的是服務很有温度。崔經理和幾個酒店的小夥子非常熱情。孩子生病了就安排了小米粥，特別安排了延遲退房。非常好的住宿體驗。
translatedContent: A very classic Old Beijing courtyard house with a great environment and excellent soundproofing. What's even more commendable is the warm service. Manager Cui and the hotel staff were incredibly enthusiastic. When my child fell ill, they arranged for millet porridge and even allowed a late check-out. A truly wonderful stay.

content: 魏家衚衕裏保存完好的老四合院值得專程來住！青磚灰瓦、雕花迴廊移步皆是景，院內清幽靜謐，隔絕街巷嘈雜。原生古建搭配玻璃穹頂設計獨具巧思，閑坐院中可以盡享老城獨有的安逸氛圍感。客房床品舒適，備的是帕爾瑪之水的洗護用品，步行可達隆福寺商圈，衚衕雖窄但是打車定位魏家衚衕/東四北大街都很省心。
translatedContent: The well-preserved old courtyard houses in Weijia Hutong are worth a special trip! With their blue bricks and gray tiles, carved corridors, and picturesque scenery at every turn, the courtyards offer a tranquil escape from the noise of the streets. The original ancient architecture paired with a glass dome design is ingenious, allowing you to fully enjoy the unique peaceful atmosphere of the old town. The guest rooms offer comfortable bedding and provide Acqua di Parma toiletries. The Longfusi commercial area is within walking distance, and although the hutong is narrow, hailing a taxi to Weijia Hutong/Dongsi North Street is very convenient.

content: 除了早餐差，其它都好。值得體驗。
translatedContent: Aside from the poor breakfast, everything else was great. Worth trying.

content: 無法不讚歎這衚衕裏的四合院！安靜，乾淨，無比愜意，價格合適，附近小吃豐富，值得推薦！我會再來！
translatedContent: I can't help but admire the courtyard houses in this alley! Quiet, clean, incredibly pleasant, reasonably priced, and with plenty of snacks nearby, I highly recommend it! I'll definitely come back!

content: 非常滿意，很好
translatedContent: Very satisfied, excellent.

content: 值得被推薦和再次入住！下次來北京還會再次選擇
translatedContent: Highly recommended and definitely worth a repeat stay! I'll choose this hotel again next time I'm in Beijing.

content: 洗澡衞浴需要更換
translatedContent: The shower and bathroom facilities need to be updated.

content: 安靜有北京特色
translatedContent: Quiet and characteristic of Beijing

content: 外國友人很滿意
translatedContent: Our foreign friends were very satisfied.

content: Замечательный стильный отель. Красивый интерьер, внимательный персонал. Хороший завтрак. Все очень понравилось!!!
translatedContent: Wonderful, stylish hotel. Beautiful interior, attentive staff. Good breakfast. We loved everything!!!

content: 時光回流. 床特別舒服！ 冬天有地暖. 胡同里十分安靜. 走一點就到大街吃飯. 很特別的体驗.
translatedContent: Time seemed to rewind. The bed was incredibly comfortable! There was underfloor heating in winter. The alley was very quiet. A short walk took you to the main street for dining. It was a truly unique experience.

content: 平淡無奇的胡同裡，有間不平凡的酒店。在平凡不过的入口，卻存著出人意料的精典收藏，充份顯示著東家的用心。經典四合院裡，充滿著生活的趣味，搭配著前台服务的極致用心，值得細細品味。
translatedContent: In an unremarkable alley, there lies an extraordinary hotel. Its unassuming entrance conceals an unexpected collection of classic artifacts, showcasing the owner's meticulous attention to detail. The classic courtyard house is brimming with the charm of everyday life, complemented by exceptional front desk service, making it a place worth savoring.

content: 古城老院真不錯，古韻悠悠超有感覺！房間很舒服，設施餐飲都很好。管家很熱情，推薦的餐廳很棒。下次還會來
translatedContent: The old courtyard in the ancient city was truly wonderful, exuding a timeless charm! The rooms were very comfortable, and the facilities and dining were excellent. The butler was very welcoming, and the restaurant recommendations were fantastic. I'll definitely come back next time.

content: 入住北京古城老院的體驗簡直是一場穿越時空的驚喜,院子保留了老四合院的原貌,接待員熱情又貼心,像朋友一樣天南地北聊個不停,另外從胡同步行到南鑼古巷只要十分鐘,卻避開了主街的擁擠,鬧中取靜,去故宮景山也只須地鐵幾站,所以這不僅是一家漂亮的四合院,更是一個能讓人放慢腳步,感受老北京靈魂的家,如果想在繁華的北京尋一個心安之所,這裡決對是五星首選,下次來北京,一定再住這裡。
translatedContent: Staying at the Old Courtyard in Beijing's Ancient City was a delightful experience, a journey through time. The courtyard retains the original appearance of an old-style siheyuan (traditional courtyard house), and the staff were warm and attentive, chatting like friends about everything under the sun. It's only a ten-minute walk from the hutongs to Nanluoguxiang, avoiding the congestion of the main street and offering a tranquil escape. The Forbidden City and Jingshan Park are just a few subway stops away. Therefore, this is not only a beautiful siheyuan, but also a home where you can slow down and experience the soul of old Beijing. If you're looking for a peaceful retreat in bustling Beijing, this is definitely a top choice, a five-star option. I'll definitely stay here again next time I'm in Beijing.

content: 僅有4間客房的精品酒店！地處鬧市區，但在衚衕四合院內，鬧中取靜，自成天地。進到院落，無論從字畫布置，綠植搭配，都體現出店家的雅緻品味。房間裏配置自然是極高的，但更難得的是這些裝飾，色調搭配與酒店的風情配合無間。浴室衞生間很大，唯一美中不足的是洗浴水壓有點不足，僅滿足基本沖淋需求，浪費了店家配的TOTO NEOREST 三功能淋浴柱，略有遺憾。
translatedContent: This boutique hotel has only four rooms! Nestled in a bustling city center, it offers a tranquil escape within a hutong courtyard, a world of its own. Entering the courtyard, the elegant decor, paintings, and plantings reflect the hotel's refined taste. The rooms are naturally well-appointed, but even more remarkable is the décor and color palette that seamlessly complements the hotel's ambiance. The bathroom is spacious, but the only drawback is the water pressure, which is a bit lacking, barely sufficient for a basic shower, wasting the included TOTO NEOREST three-function showerhead.

content: 包了南院住，整體非常棒，檔次層次算是民營頂奢度假酒店，與那些連鎖大品牌酒店的豪華不一樣，你能看得出來老闆完全不差錢且品味甚高，不為掙錢就是給有品的人提供文化享受，這院子格局方正，在翻修/裝飾/佈景等細節上也是下了血本，客房內也都是超五星標準，床和枕頭是我睡過最舒適的沒有之一。當然了客房內還擺放着些明顯不屬於這個年代的老物件，增色不少。這種文物級小院且住且珍惜。
translatedContent: We booked a stay at the South Courtyard, which was fantastic overall. It's a top-tier private luxury resort hotel, unlike those luxury chain hotels. You can tell the owner has plenty of money and exquisite taste, and isn't in it just to make money, but to provide cultural enjoyment for discerning people. The courtyard is square in shape, and they've invested heavily in the renovation, decoration, and scenery. The rooms are also above five-star standards, and the beds and pillows are the most comfortable I've ever slept on. Of course, the rooms are decorated with some vintage items that clearly don't belong to this era, which adds a lot of charm. This heritage-level courtyard is a must-stay and cherish.

content: 設施完備十分乾淨，院子方正服務周到很好
translatedContent: The facilities are complete and very clean, the yard is square and the service is thoughtful and good

content: 很讚的四合院老宅子，進出也方便。厲家菜值得品嚐😋
房間很不錯，正宗的北京四合院，儀式感滿滿，另外管家大哥特別健談，非常熱情

在北京真正切身體驗四合院環境為數不多的品牌，廂房正房加起來不過四間而已，私密性非常好。

院主人主理裝修規劃下了心血，雕樑畫棟，光檐頭的彩繪，就文人畫和透視兩種畫法，內部裝修莊重大氣；收藏的傢俱字畫供客人觀賞使用，顯品味。

工作人員熱情、有人情味，太好了。
translatedContent:
It is one of the few brands in Beijing that can truly experience the Siheyuan environment. There are only four rooms in the wing and main room, and the privacy is very good.

The owner of the courtyard has put a lot of effort in the decoration planning. The carved beams and painted buildings, the eaves are painted in two ways, literati painting and perspective painting. The interior decoration is solemn and majestic; the collection of furniture and calligraphy and paintings is for guests to enjoy and use, showing taste.

The staff is warm and humane, which is great.

content: 古城老院的房間乾淨舒適，管家的服務周到細緻。傳統的四合院落精緻典雅，坐在院落中央的椅子休息，玉蘭海棠相映，偶爾傳來幾聲鳥鳴，很好地體驗到古韻悠悠庭院的雅緻。早餐是中式的，豐富多樣，味道也好，有粥、油條、餃子、魚柳、小籠包、饅頭、兩樣開胃涼菜、餛飩紫菜湯和水果。總體來説，來北京一趟住進古城老院真是不枉此行。
translatedContent: The rooms in Gucheng Laoyuan are clean and comfortable, and the housekeeper's service is thoughtful and meticulous. The traditional courtyard is exquisite and elegant. Sitting on the chair in the middle of the courtyard to rest, the magnolia and crabapple are in harmony, and occasionally there are a few birds singing, which is a good experience of the elegance of the ancient courtyard. The breakfast is Chinese, rich and varied, and the taste is good. There are porridge, fried dough sticks, dumplings, fish fillets, steamed buns, steamed buns, two appetizers, wonton seaweed soup and fruits. Overall, it is worthwhile to come to Beijing and stay in Gucheng Laoyuan.

translatedContent: Very good stay experience, good service attitude, warm and friendly hospitality, elegant environment, good location, and clean. Although the breakfast is a set meal, the six-square grid has different styles and tastes good. It is made with great care, especially the dumplings are made with real ingredients. The detergents used in the bathroom are all high-end brands. It is worthy of being a boutique hotel. Next time I go to Beijing, I will choose to stay in this hotel.

content:
藏在衚衕裏的SLH  體驗了一把四合院精品酒店 昔日SLH的頭銜還是硬保證 要比衚衕裏的民宿靠譜太多[贊R]
❣️供住客使用的黃花梨傢俱
❣️親眼目睹林風眠的真跡
❣️觸碰雍正時期的水缸
❣️讓人驚歎的各種成套藏酒
❣️熱情局氣的老北京前台
❣️無水泥特殊工藝的磚壘手藝
❣️純手繪壁畫圖案和榫卯結構
❣️兼具美感和功能性的陽光玻璃頂
真是別樣又難忘的住宿體驗，但不得不承認冬天確實不太適合住在衚衕裏 即便有地暖和暖風的雙重加持 還是會有一點冷 好在有超快的熱水🛀🏻因為住店客人少 所以早餐都是大廚現做**🥗🍲🍳🍎🍈🍵 任一餐品如果不夠都可以要求再加 清淡又不失風味 很好吃
不足之處，房間裏有線電視看不了，座機用不了😂
translatedContent:
SLH hidden in the hutong. Experienced a boutique hotel in a courtyard. The title of SLH in the past is still a solid guarantee. It is much more reliable than the B&B in the hutong [thumbs up]
❣️Huanghuali furniture for guests
❣️See the original works of Lin Fengmian with your own eyes
❣️Touch the water tanks from the Yongzheng period
❣️Amazing sets of ******* wine
❣️Warm and generous old Beijing front desk
❣️Bricklaying craftsmanship with special cement-free technology
❣️Pure hand-painted murals and mortise and tenon structure
❣️Sunlight glass roof with both beauty and functionality
It is a unique and unforgettable accommodation experience, but I have to admit that it is not suitable to live in the hutong in winter. Even with the dual blessing of floor heating and warm wind, it will still be a little cold. Fortunately, there is super fast hot water🛀🏻Because there are few guests staying in the hotel, breakfast is freshly made by the chef**🥗🍲🍳🍎🍈🍵 If any dish is not enough, you can ask for more Light but tasty.
The downside is that I can't watch cable TV in the room and the landline can't be used😂

He had the large suite for 4 nights in late October 2024.
Four key things:
1- this is a hotel with only 4 rooms smack on the Longtangs. That, alone, is extraordinary,
2- It is in the architecture of an ancient courtyard -- which is a rarity in Beijing for a hotel.
3- This is a high end room with a really nice breakfast.
4- The staff it really helpful.
I don't think there is anything better in Beijing in the old courtyard style.
Highly recommend.
Jean-Marc (Canada).

content: 服務非常好，餐廳品質也很不錯，非常滿意
translatedContent: The service is very good, the restaurant quality is also very good, very satisfied

content: 體驗四合院最理想的酒店。設施齊全環境優美鄧注意可能距離地鐵站要少少步程時間。因為是胡同內，所以如果打車進來，有時司機會在外面落客，不入胡同內。
translatedContent: Experience the most ideal hotel in the courtyard. The facilities are complete and the environment is beautiful. Please note that it may be a short walk from the subway station. Because it is in an alley, if you take a taxi, sometimes the driver will drop you off outside and not enter the alley.

content: 高端的雅緻和品味，老北京獨有的人情味兒，極佳的四合院體驗。 期待再次相遇
translatedContent: High-end elegance and taste, unique human touch of old Beijing, and excellent courtyard experience. Looking forward to seeing you again

content: 非常有特色和品質的四合院酒店，強烈推薦。
translatedContent: A very distinctive and high-quality courtyard hotel, highly recommended.

content: 一座有歷史文化背景的城市，一幢有份量的住宅，聽着管家娓娓道來，有種身臨其境的感覺。看着不起眼的小物件，動輒幾百年，贊歎驚訝聲不絕於耳。下次來北京還有選擇小住一晚。
translatedContent: A city with a historical and cultural background, a house with weight, listening to the butler's story, I felt like I was there. Looking at the inconspicuous little objects, which are hundreds of years old, I was amazed and surprised. I will choose to stay here for a night next time I come to Beijing.

content:
設施：很有特色
衞生：不錯
環境：很有北京特色
服務：都很棒
精緻四合院充滿古色古香的老北京風情，值得體驗。
translatedContent: The exquisite courtyard house is full of quaint old Beijing style and is worth experiencing.

content: 環境非常好，去哪裡都近
translatedContent: Very good environment, close to everywhere

content: 這次被魏家衚衕這家酒店驚艷了，六百多年的四合院打理的環境清幽，屋檐壁畫承載歷史故事，套房佈局合理，古色古香。服務人員熱情周到，老北京文化氣息濃厚！贊！遇到困難店裡經理也幫助解決！值得推薦！
translatedContent: This time I was amazed by this hotel in Weijia Hutong. The environment of the courtyard house, which is more than 600 years old, is quiet. The murals on the eaves carry historical stories. The suites are well-planned and antique. The service staff is warm and thoughtful, and the old Beijing culture is strong! Great! The store manager also helps to solve problems when encountering difficulties! Worth recommending!

content: 管家服務很熱情，酒店環境也很安靜，是真正的四合院，很有北京特色，值得推薦。
translatedContent: The butler service is very enthusiastic and the hotel environment is very quiet. It is a real courtyard house with Beijing characteristics and is worth recommending.

content: 房間很好，值得入住，服務方面晚班的有待提高。
translatedContent: The room is very good and worth staying in. The service of the night shift needs to be improved.

content: 酒店很小，就東南西北4個房間，很像民宿。為了體驗四合院去的，價格不便宜，感受就很一般
translatedContent: The hotel is very small, with only 4 rooms in the east, south, west and north, much like a homestay. I went there to experience the Siheyuan, the price is not cheap, and the experience is very average

content: 每次來北京都是選擇住四合院的，這家服務好，衞生好，環境好，下次會再住
translatedContent: Every time I come to Beijing, I choose to stay in a courtyard house. This one has good service, good hygiene, and good environment. I will stay here again next time.

content: 非常好！值得信賴！
translatedContent: Very good! Trustworthy!

content: 服務態度超級好！房間內裝修也很有氛圍感！真的物所超值！
translatedContent: The service attitude is super good! The interior decoration of the room is also very atmospheric! Really great value for money!

content:
服務超級滿意，每一位工作人員都非常熱情，非常棒，超級好的一次入住體驗～
早餐也很不錯，都是現做的，小米粥配蘿蔔絲好好吃！！！麪也很不錯
洗護是帕爾瑪之水的，紙巾也是德寶的，品質很可以～
唯一可能有一點兒美中不足的，就是房間比較老，細節處還需要再維護一下
translatedContent:
The service is super satisfying. Every staff member is very enthusiastic and great. It’s a great stay experience~
The breakfast is also very good, all freshly made, and the millet porridge with shredded radish is delicious! ! ! Noodles are also very good
The washing and care products are from Eau de Parma and the paper towels are from Debao. The quality is very good~
The only thing that may have a slight flaw is that the room is relatively old and the details need to be maintained.

content: 過年帶着小朋友來北京遊玩。特地挑選了大宅院，體驗非常好。環境非常棒，晚上回到酒店，有種回家的感覺。強烈推薦！
translatedContent: I took my children to Beijing during the Chinese New Year. I specially selected a large house and the experience was very good. The environment is great. When I return to the hotel in the evening, I feel like I'm at home. highly recommended!

content: 有種家的感覺，四合院真的衹有四個房間。
translatedContent: It feels like home, as the courtyard really only has four rooms.

content: 皇城根腳下的小四合院，親切的老北京人式服務，地道的早餐。
translatedContent: A small courtyard at the foot of the Imperial City, friendly old Beijing service, and authentic breakfast.

content: 非常好，推薦入住
translatedContent: Very good, recommended

content: 非常滿意一次入住

因為小孩説要住四合院，在網上找了很久有四合院味道的四合院，比較了很多家，最終訂了這裏。來了也沒有失望，總體滿意，四合院格局，保留了這種中式的味道，院裏處處體現了房東的用心。
酒店對客人的訴求也很上心，比如我們剛反映浴室的水壓太大，第二天管家就把問題解決了，而且也會根據客人的口味調整食品，服務是到位的。
如果稍有不足，我自己還是不算太喜歡客房裡的一些混搭，比如浴室地板的大紅毯子，我覺着有些敗筆了，如果能堅持整個中式的搭配會更完美。座椅的擺設也稍有欠缺，正對浴室。可以調整一下。這些都是精益求精的建議。
總體住得舒服，會推薦朋友入住。
translatedContent:
Because my child wanted to live in a courtyard house, I searched online for a courtyard house that had the flavor of a courtyard house for a long time. I compared many houses and finally booked this place. I was not disappointed when I came here. I am generally satisfied. The courtyard layout retains this Chinese flavor, and the landlord's intentions are reflected in every aspect of the courtyard.
The hotel is also very attentive to the guests' demands. For example, we just reported that the water pressure in the bathroom was too high, and the housekeeper solved the problem the next day, and also adjusted the food according to the guests' tastes. The service was in place.
If there are some shortcomings, I still don't like some of the mix and match in the guest room, such as the bright red blanket on the bathroom floor. I think it is a bit of a failure. It would be more perfect if the whole Chinese style match could be adhered to. The seating arrangement is also slightly lacking, facing the bathroom. Can be adjusted. These are suggestions for excellence.
Overall, it was a comfortable stay and I would recommend it to friends.

content: 絕對超讚感受。平時住在後沙峪，特意帶娃們進城住幾日老北京四合院。24小時前台專人服務，過了前廳，便是豁然開朗一個四合院，一共就四套客房。前廳、院子及房間內的景色和家居擺設所有真的是精品。可以説是鬧市裡的靜謐安詳。
translatedContent: Absolutely awesome feeling. I usually live in Houshayu, and I took my children to the city to stay in an old Beijing courtyard house for a few days. There is a 24-hour front desk dedicated to service. After passing the front hall, you will suddenly find a courtyard with a total of four guest rooms. The scenery and home furnishings in the front hall, yard and rooms are all truly exquisite. It can be said that it is quiet and peaceful in the busy city.

content:
房間很寬敞，床很大，有個院子很舒服，坐在院子裏曬太陽喝咖啡發呆很安靜舒服愜意。建築和裏面的很多擺設都是很有來頭的。
最喜歡的是酒店的服務人員，周到熱情有禮節制，沒有制式的標準的冷淡，也不會熱情過分。整個幾天住下來感覺上是很放鬆舒服的。再去北京還是會去住。
translatedContent:
The room is very spacious, the bed is big, and there is a very comfortable yard. Sitting in the yard basking in the sun and drinking coffee is very quiet and comfortable. The building and many of the furnishings inside are of great origin.
What I like most is the service staff of the hotel. They are attentive, enthusiastic and polite. They are not cold and indifferent to standard standards, nor are they overly enthusiastic. I felt very relaxed and comfortable throughout my stay of several days. I will still stay there if I go to Beijing again.

content:
這次國慶節帶着家裡長者來北京旅遊，住進了古城老院。
環境很安靜、私密，睡眠不好的媽媽也能安心休息。
院子敞亮、平坦，婆婆早起也可以鍛鍊身體。
早餐分中西兩種，因為婆婆年紀大了，管家小哥哥小姐姐們還單獨煲了小米粥，真是十分感謝，婆婆還一直説小米粥和豆腐腦很好吃，我覺得咖啡和燕麥很好吃😋
匆匆住了三晚，體驗很舒服，婆婆在路上一直在説忘記了和管家小崔他們道謝，那麼，就在此感謝本次照顧我們的所有工作人員
translatedContent:
This National Day, I took my elderly family members to Beijing for a trip and stayed in an old hospital in the ancient city.
The environment is quiet and private, so mothers who have trouble sleeping can rest peacefully.
The yard is bright and flat, so my mother-in-law can exercise when she gets up early.
There are two kinds of breakfast, Chinese and Western. Because my mother-in-law is old, the housekeepers also cooked millet porridge separately. Thank you very much. My mother-in-law always said that millet porridge and tofu are delicious. I think coffee and oatmeal are delicious. 😋
We stayed for three nights in a hurry and the experience was very comfortable. My mother-in-law kept saying on the way that she forgot to thank the housekeeper Xiaocui and the others. So, I would like to thank all the staff who took care of us this time.

content: 院子很舒服，特別喜歡櫃子用的鎖。早餐很豐盛食量小的妹子建議選擇不要全選。酒店小哥哥小姐姐都很熱情服務很周到呢
translatedContent: The yard is very comfortable, and I especially like the locks for the cabinets. The breakfast is very rich. Girls with small appetites are advised not to choose everything. The guys and girls in the hotel are very warm and attentive.

content: 超級贊，北京四合院建築的體驗精品之所
translatedContent: Super awesome, a great place to experience Beijing’s courtyard architecture
